# recurrence rule text

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:recurrenceRuleText`](gmeow-recurrenceRuleText.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/recurrenceRuleText>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The recurrence rule as an RFC 5545 RRULE string (e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO). Projected directly to iCalendar RRULE; a SET-typed TIMEX3 in ISO-TimeML.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](../classes/gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:recurrenceRuleText`](gmeow-recurrenceRuleText.md) from [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](../classes/gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the recurrence as an RFC 5545 RRULE string (FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO) on a [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](../classes/gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) — the authored, projection-ready form.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the recurrence as parsed sub-properties in core (the string is the source of truth) and avoid putting it directly on an event or series instead of on the [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](../classes/gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) node.

### How to use

- Assert one RFC 5545 RRULE [xsd:string](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) per [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](../classes/gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) via [`gmeow:recurrenceRuleText`](gmeow-recurrenceRuleText.md) (functional); it projects straight to iCalendar RRULE.

### Examples

- ex:weeklyMon [`gmeow:recurrenceRuleText`](gmeow-recurrenceRuleText.md) "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO".
